snippet.title: Project Spectrum | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Project Spectrum Official gamescom 2025 Opening Night Live trailer! 

A new tactical thriller shooter unveils. Step into the reality-warped Ember Zones, where satisfying gunplay meets a mesmerizing, high-style world… but beware: unspeakable horrors lurk within.

Face the horror… or become it.

Stay tuned for more details: spectrum-project.com
